def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must be numpy arrays")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must be 2-dimensional")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must contain only finite values")
        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must contain log probabilities (<=0)")
    if not np.allclose(logp_with_result.shape, logp_call_only.shape) or \
       not np.allclose(logp_with_result.shape, logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have the same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isscalar(tau_filter) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative scalar")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if weight_sum == 0:
        normalized_weights = np.ones_like(raw_weights) / future_horizon
    else:
        normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum

    # Compute weighted negative log probability losses
    L_no_call = -np.dot(logp_no_call, normalized_weights)
    L_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, normalized_weights)
    L_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, normalized_weights)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep.astype(bool), margin.astype(float)
